speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me determine the cause, could you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if they worsen with activity? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your weight, appetite, or sleep patterns recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given your recent travel, hiking, camping, and multiple illnesses, could you specify the nature of those recent illnesses and whether you have experienced any fevers, rashes, or joint pain? Also, have you noticed any swollen glands or muscle aches?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of progressive weakness, fatigue, and specifically mild diplopia (double vision) is highly characteristic of this condition affecting the neuromuscular junction, distinguishing it from simple infectious etiologies suggested by your recent travel.
